common.app_tagline: Complete the Qur'an in seven days with a simple daily reminder and progress tracker.

onboarding.step1_tagline: Complete the Qur'an in seven days with a simple daily reminder and progress tracker.
onboarding.hadith_quote: اقرأ القرآن في سبع ولا تزد على ذلك
onboarding.step2_title: When would you like to begin?
onboarding.step2_desc: Your 7-day khatmah will run for 7 consecutive days starting from your chosen date.
onboarding.step3_desc: We will send one gentle daily reminder with today's assigned reading portion.
onboarding.reminder_note: No spam or aggressive messaging. If you complete your portion early, we will not send that day's reminder.
onboarding.step4_desc: Please review your challenge plan before beginning.

home.behind_schedule_desc: You have missed portions. You can continue today's portion or adjust your plan.
home.concluded_desc: Your 7-day period has concluded. You can start a fresh 7-day journey whenever you are ready.

progress.title: Your Journey
progress.concluded_banner_desc: The 7-day timeframe has elapsed. Completed: {} of 7 portions.
progress.no_cycles_sub: Start a new 7-day challenge to record your reading consistency.
progress.tips_body: Try to keep your daily time consistent. Even a small step makes a big difference!
progress.demo_data_loaded: Demo cycles loaded! Explore past months.

adjust_plan.title: Adjust Remaining Plan
adjust_plan.description: We redistributed your unread portions consecutively across the remaining days of your khatmah. Completed portions are preserved.
adjust_plan.concluded_desc:
Your 7-day challenge period has ended. The plan cannot be adjusted because there are no active days remaining.

You can start a new 7-day khatmah from the home or progress screen anytime.

completion_dialog.title: Alhamdulillah
completion_dialog.subtitle: You completed your 7-day khatmah.
completion_dialog.dua: May Allah accept your recitation and make it a light in your heart.

settings.title: Settings
settings.daily_reminder_desc: Receive gentle daily notice for your assigned portion
settings.restart_dialog_desc: Your current progress will be reset back to Day 1. This action cannot be undone.
settings.new_dialog_desc: Your current challenge is still in progress. Starting a new one will archive your current progress.
settings.app_desc: A companion for completing the Qur'an in seven days. This app helps you stay committed to your daily recitation.
settings.hadith_text: The Prophet ﷺ instructed ʿAbdullah ibn ʿAmr to recite the Qur'an in seven days: "Read it in seven days, and do not exceed that."
settings.load_demo_history_desc: Populate past months with completed 7-day cycles for testing
settings.clear_history_desc: Remove completed and demo khatmahs from history

confirmation.mark_completed_desc: Have you finished reading today's portion (Day {})?
confirmation.undo_desc: Would you like to mark today's portion as incomplete?
confirmation.continue_today_desc: You have missed portions from earlier days. Do you want to proceed with today's portion without adjusting your schedule?
confirmation.adjust_plan_desc: Would you like to review and redistribute your remaining uncompleted portions across your remaining days?
confirmation.apply_plan_desc: This will redistribute your remaining portions across your remaining days. This updates your daily schedule.
